entities.summary: Asuman Karakoyun is a retired Turkish volleyball player. She is 180 cm (5.9 ft) tall and played as a Setter. She played for Eczacıbaşı VitrA and wore the number 8. On 23 August 2016, she announced her retirement at the age of 26 after more than one year's absence from the sport due to knee injury.
